description: This file defines the class TbCanvasDigitalGauge, which manages a digital gauge widget in the Thingsboard platform. It includes initialization, updating, resizing, and destruction of the gauge, utilizing external libraries like 'canvas-gauges' and Angular components.

classes.name: TbCanvasDigitalGauge
classes.description: A class representing a digital gauge widget for Thingsboard, handling rendering, updates, and interactions with gauge settings and data.

methods.name: toRadians
methods.description: Converts an angle from degrees to radians.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the gauge, sets up subscriptions for ticks, and prepares the gauge for display.

methods.name: updateAttribute
methods.description: Updates gauge tick values based on data subscription.

methods.name: updateSetting
methods.description: Applies current settings to the gauge and updates its display.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the gauge with the latest data, including timestamp and value.

methods.name: mobileModeChanged
methods.description: Adjusts gauge settings when mobile mode changes.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Resizes the gauge to match container dimensions.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources and subscriptions when the gauge is destroyed.
